title: PrePay Power (Prepaid Metering) Policy: Combination With Deposits, Medical Certificates, Budget Billing, Arrangements and Late Charges
content:
**Section 1.** The following switches set how PrePay Power (Prepaid Metering) combines with the other programs of the cooperative. They take the same value on every tier: PrePay Power Residential, PrePay Power Residential Recovery 25, PrePay Power Residential Recovery 40, PrePay Power Seasonal, PrePay Power Outbuilding and PrePay Power Small Commercial.

| Switch | Value on every tier |
|---|---|
| Security deposit required while on the tier | no |
| Deposit already held at enrollment | applied first to reduce the arrears to be transferred; the rest is credited to the prepaid balance |
| Enrollment allowed while under active medical certificate protection | no |
| Budget Billing plan may stay on the service account while on the tier | no |
| Active payment arrangement may stay on the service account while on the tier | no |
| Late payment charges apply while on the tier | no |

**Section 2.** Because no deposit is required on any tier, none is assessed while the account is on PrePay Power; a deposit already held at enrollment is not kept as a deposit but released in the order shown above.

**Section 3.** Because late payment charges do not apply on any tier, no late payment charge is assessed on a PrePay Power account.
